messages.subject: SGS Thailand | Assurance, ESG and regulated-industry leadership
messages.body:
Dear SGS Thailand Leadership Team,

SGS operates at the point where industrial performance, compliance, verification and stakeholder trust meet, which closely reflects my current responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, compliance coordination, executive communications and cross-functional delivery.

I bring client-side experience preparing evidence for regulators, supporting carbon-data readiness, coordinating audits and inspections, and translating external requirements into accountable internal action. That perspective would be valuable in senior client, sustainability, strategic partnership or country-facing roles.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or ASEAN mandates across ESG, Strategic Partnerships, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations or responsible-business leadership. I have attached an SGS Thailand-focused executive CV.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
